info.title: LockSec Doc API
info.description:
Base URL: `/api/v1`

All successful responses follow `{ message, data }`. Errors follow `{ message, statusCode, timestamp, path, method }`.

For protected endpoints, pass `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`.

get.description: Returns the full (non-sensitive) user document for the currently authenticated user.

hasPassword.description: True if the user has set a login password.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account and all associated data.
**Warning:** This action is irreversible. All user data will be permanently removed.

**What gets deleted:**
- User account and profile
- Associated business profiles
- User's bookings and transactions
- Audit logs related to the user
